uniteDbPokemon.notes: Unite-DB public pokemon.json. v3 enumerates skills, boosted basic attacks, nested upgrade choices, Plus/enhanced effects, Unite Moves, and Unite Buffs.

sourceList.originalDescription: This Pokémon's critical-hit rate is increased by an additional 15%. Increased Critical-Hit rate by 15%.

Becomes a boosted attack with every third attack, and decreasing their Defense by 15% for 2s when the attack hits. If this boosted attack hits only a single target, it deals bonus damage. Becomes a boosted attack with every third attack, dealing damage to enemies and lowering their Defense by 15% for 2s when it hits. If this boosted attack hits only a single target, it deals increased damage.

Becomes a boosted attack with every third attack, dealing damage to enemies and lowering their Defense by 15% for 2s when it hits. If this boosted attack hits only a single target, it deals increased damage.

The user dashes in an arc forward, damaging Pokémon in the path and increasing the user's basic attack speed by 60% for 0.5s when this move hits. This move ignores the Defense and shield effects of Pokémon hit. Each use alternates between a rightward and leftward arc. Dash in an arc, attacking enemies that come in contact with Absol. This move ignores the defense stat and shield effects of enemies.

The user dashes in a leftward arc forward, damaging non-allied Pokémon in its path and increasing the user's basic attack speed by 60% for 0.5s when this dash hits. If this dash hits, the move can be used again within 6s. This second use has the user dash straight ahead, repeating the effects of the first dash when it hits. The critical-hit rate of this move is increased by 0.8% for every 1% missing HP of opposing Pokémon hit, up to 30% increased critical-hit rate at 38% missing HP or more. The first use is a rightward arc forward from the perspective of the orange team (right-side team, which has the map flipped horizontally when in battle). Dash in an outward arc, dealing damage to enemies. If this first attack hits, a second attack can also be performed. The second attack has the user dash straight ahead, dealing damage to enemies and increasing the user's critical-hit rate. The lower the enemies HP, the more the user's critical-hit rate is increased.
Restores the user's HP for 50% of damage dealt with the second dash hit. Using this move again will restore the user's HP.

The user dashes forward, empowering the next auto attack for 3s. With this empowered attack, the user leaps to a non-allied Pokémon and attacks. This damage is increased against targets hit in the back. If this empowered attack hits any target in the back, this move's cooldown is reduced by 70%. When the user has an empowered attack readied, nearby non-allied Pokémon have their backs highlighted. Dash to the designated location and quickly charge an enemy with the next basic attack. (Basic attack range is doubled while this effect is active). If the basic attack lands from behind, its damage is increased and this move's cooldown is reduced.
Increases the user's movement speed by 35% for 2s after using this move and before using the empowered attack. Increased movement speed.

The user slashes in the designated direction, damaging opposing Pokémon hit. This move's critical-hit rate is increased by 15%. Slash with sharp claws in front of the user, increasing this move's critical-hit rate.

The user throws a psychic slash in the designated direction, damaging opposing Pokémon hit and decreasing their movement speed by 90% for 2s (decaying by 25% every 0.5s). 3 marks are applied to opposing Pokémon hit by the psychic slash for 5s. When the user deals damage to a marked target, 1 mark is consumed, dealing additional damage. The third mark deals increased damage when consumed. The critical-hit rate of the psychic slash and consumed marks is increased by 15%. The marks can be cleansed. Attack with blades formed by psychic power that decrease the movement speed of enemies for a short time when this move hits. Also increases basic attack damage dealt to the affected enemy for up to 3 attacks after this move hits.
Increases the user's movement speed by 20% when an opposing Pokémon is marked by this move. Also increases movement speed for a short time when the user gets close to the enemy that this move hit.

The user becomes unstoppable and targets an opposing Pokémon and enters a counter stance for 1s, decreasing the movement speed of the user and the target by 50% for the duration. After 1s, the user leaves the counter stance to counterattack, charging behind the target and damaging the target and other opposing Pokémon. If the user is attacked or the target attacks during the counter stance, however, the user dodges the damage and effects of the first hit and immediately counterattacks, shoving the target and dealing increased damage to the target and other opposing Pokémon. Look for an opening to attack an enemy, decreasing the movement speed of the user and the target enemy for the duration. After a short time, charge forward to attack the enemy. However, if the user receives damage or gets attacked before it charges, attack immediately and shove the enemy.
Increases the user's basic attack speed by 40% for 3s after using this move. Increases basic attack speed for a short time when this move hits.

The user briefly becomes unstoppable before becoming untargetable and invulnerable for 1.15s while unleashing a flurry of 5 slashes in front of themself in the designated area, damaging opposing Pokémon in the area of effect. The user then becomes unstoppable again and unleashes a final slash in front of them with 3 blades of energy, shoving opposing Pokémon and dealing damage, up to 4 times at close range and down to 1 time at maximum range. The damage of the flurry of 5 slashes is divided by the number of targets hit. The first hit from the final slash deals full damage to each target hit; subsequent hits deal 30% of the full damage to the same target. 30% of the full damage. Unleashes a flurry of slashes in front of the user. This move ends by unleashing powerful blades of energy, dealing increased damage to enemies and shoves them.
Buffs: 80% Movement Speed, 20% Max HP Shield Buff duration: 6

source.name: Sucker Punch
source.originalDescription: The user becomes unstoppable and targets an opposing Pokémon and enters a counter stance for 1s, decreasing the movement speed of the user and the target by 50% for the duration. After 1s, the user leaves the counter stance to counterattack, charging behind the target and damaging the target and other opposing Pokémon. If the user is attacked or the target attacks during the counter stance, however, the user dodges the damage and effects of the first hit and immediately counterattacks, shoving the target and dealing increased damage to the target and other opposing Pokémon. Look for an opening to attack an enemy, decreasing the movement speed of the user and the target enemy for the duration. After a short time, charge forward to attack the enemy. However, if the user receives damage or gets attacked before it charges, attack immediately and shove the enemy.
source.translatedDescription: 機械要約: Sucker Punch は 相手を押し出す、妨害無効になる、遅延または時間差でダメージを与える、スタック、マーク、ゲージを扱う、フォーム・モード・構えを変化させる。

source.name: Midnight Slash
source.originalDescription: The user briefly becomes unstoppable before becoming untargetable and invulnerable for 1.15s while unleashing a flurry of 5 slashes in front of themself in the designated area, damaging opposing Pokémon in the area of effect. The user then becomes unstoppable again and unleashes a final slash in front of them with 3 blades of energy, shoving opposing Pokémon and dealing damage, up to 4 times at close range and down to 1 time at maximum range. The damage of the flurry of 5 slashes is divided by the number of targets hit. The first hit from the final slash deals full damage to each target hit; subsequent hits deal 30% of the full damage to the same target. 30% of the full damage. Unleashes a flurry of slashes in front of the user. This move ends by unleashing powerful blades of energy, dealing increased damage to enemies and shoves them.
source.translatedDescription: 機械要約: Midnight Slash は 相手を押し出す、妨害無効になる、対象指定されない、またはステルス状態になる。
